6309.title: Interrupted working-directory lookup aborts provider initialization
6309.rootCauseOneLine: The Claude SDK reads process.cwd() during module evaluation outside its realpath catch; an interrupted read rejects the provider import and the bridge worker exits.
6309.proposedFix: Bounded EINTR retry at the SDK-owned cwd read, preserving permanent failures.
6309.caveats: Injected failure only; the native signal and original desktop runtime were not reproduced. Scripts and logs are inline in the report. No safe simple fix within dependency/packaging constraints.
